name: Base Game
notes: PC launch Nov 5 2019. Console Edition launched Mar 26 2024. Anniversary updates added Black-and-White Ruffed Lemur (2nd), Red Deer (3rd), Collared Peccary (4th), and African Leopard (5th) as free additions.

name: Deluxe Upgrade Pack
notes: PC: launched with the game Nov 2019, includes Komodo Dragon, Pygmy Hippopotamus, Thomson's Gazelle. Console: a different Deluxe Upgrade Pack was released Mar 2024 — it bundles the Wetlands Animal Pack and Southeast Asia Animal Pack animals (16 species) instead, with the original 3 PC deluxe animals not included.
